status: explicit second-order finite-Dirichlet remainder on fixed critical cutoff cells
proof_boundary: This artifact proves the C_D/T^2 per-term estimate and its fixed-cell summed C1 transfer. It does not prove the heat-integrated Riemann-Siegel a^-2 endpoint remainder, the new adjacent-cutoff signed lift, a strict contact inequality, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, or RH.

exact.region: L>=50, 0<t<=1/2, tL<=25, T>=2*pi*exp(L-1), |sigma|<=1, n<=N, and the radius-1/L disk lies in one prescribed-N cell
exact.coefficient_bound: On the critical collar, |alpha(s)|<=L/2+(1+pi)/2+2/T and log(n)<=L/2+1; hence t|alpha_n|<=27
exact.central_geometry: For T>=10^6, |v|<=V implies |w|<=V and Im(s+u*w)>=T/2 for 0<=u<=1
exact.published_tail_envelope: The pointwise envelope in the proof of Polymath Proposition 6.1 gives |I(v)|dmu<=pi^(-1/2)exp(92/T)*exp(-(1-0.26/T)v^2)dv
exact.tail_results: For T>=10^6: integral_tail |I|dmu<=T^-2, mu(tail)<=T^-3, E[v^2 1_tail]<=T^-1, and integral_tail |I-1-g|dmu<=2/T^2
exact.scalar_guards: At T=10^6, T^(1/3)=100 and T^(2/3)=10000. The exact rational bounds log(T)<14, log(2)<1, pi>157/50, and e<68/25 make all three tail logarithms negative, their derivative upper bounds negative, the central exponent <3/500, and the fixed-cell constant <8000000
exact.fixed_cell_sum: Using the two-block coefficient mass <=50*exp(L/4), sup_collar |B_t|/A_t<2, and T>=2*pi*exp(L-1): |R_D|/A_t<8000000*exp(-7L/4)
exact.fixed_cell_c1: Cauchy on the radius-1/L disk gives |partial_x R_D|/A_t<8000000*L*exp(-7L/4)
exact.remaining_splice: The fixed-N Dirichlet residual is closed. A global corrected remainder still needs the heat-integrated endpoint a^-2 bound and one adjacent-cutoff comparison for the new signed lift.

rows.claim: The first-correction gate supplies the exact centered ratio and signed coefficient.
rows.proof_boundary: Reuses the checked exact ratio; no estimate here.

rows.claim: The complete saddle shift is uniformly bounded on the critical collar.
rows.formula: L>=50, 0<t<=1/2, tL<=25, T>=2*pi*exp(L-1), |sigma|<=1, n<=N, and the radius-1/L disk lies in one prescribed-N cell; On the critical collar, |alpha(s)|<=L/2+(1+pi)/2+2/T and log(n)<=L/2+1; hence t|alpha_n|<=27; w=sqrt(t)v+c, c=t*alpha_n/2, |c|<=27/2
rows.proof_boundary: Uses only the explicit alpha formula and cutoff geometry.

rows.claim: The central segment stays uniformly in the upper half-plane.
rows.formula: V=T^(1/3); central: |v|<=V; tail: |v|>V; For T>=10^6, |v|<=V implies |w|<=V and Im(s+u*w)>=T/2 for 0<=u<=1
rows.proof_boundary: The actual critical T threshold is much larger than 10^6.

rows.claim: The explicit M_0 logarithmic derivatives have the required second-order decay.
rows.proof_boundary: Direct modulus bounds for alpha' and alpha''.

rows.claim: The Taylor and scaled-gamma remainders give one integrable central majorant.
rows.proof_boundary: Uses the DLMF complex log-gamma remainder.

rows.claim: All shifted moments needed by the central estimate are explicit.
rows.proof_boundary: The displayed inequalities deliberately round upward.

rows.claim: The central exponential remainder is second order with an explicit constant.
rows.proof_boundary: Uniform in n and t under the collar hypotheses.

rows.claim: The published quadratic envelope controls the region where a cubic Taylor exponential would fail.
rows.formula: The pointwise envelope in the proof of Polymath Proposition 6.1 gives |I(v)|dmu<=pi^(-1/2)exp(92/T)*exp(-(1-0.26/T)v^2)dv
rows.proof_boundary: This is the pointwise estimate used inside the proof of Proposition 6.1.

rows.claim: The exact integrand and correction polynomial have a negligible Gaussian tail.
rows.formula: For T>=10^6: integral_tail |I|dmu<=T^-2, mu(tail)<=T^-3, E[v^2 1_tail]<=T^-1, and integral_tail |I-1-g|dmu<=2/T^2
rows.proof_boundary: At T=10^6, T^(1/3)=100 and T^(2/3)=10000. The exact rational bounds log(T)<14, log(2)<1, pi>157/50, and e<68/25 make all three tail logarithms negative, their derivative upper bounds negative, the central exponent <3/500, and the fixed-cell constant <8000000. The stored high-precision values are margin diagnostics only.

rows.claim: Every critical Dirichlet component has an explicit uniform second-order relative remainder.
rows.proof_boundary: Fixed cutoff and its radius-1/L analytic collar.

rows.claim: Summation and Cauchy close both finite Dirichlet blocks below the next global scale.
rows.formula: Using the two-block coefficient mass <=50*exp(L/4), sup_collar |B_t|/A_t<2, and T>=2*pi*exp(L-1): |R_D|/A_t<8000000*exp(-7L/4); Cauchy on the radius-1/L disk gives |partial_x R_D|/A_t<8000000*L*exp(-7L/4); 8000000*exp(-7L/4)<0.000112*exp(-5L/4) for L>=50
rows.proof_boundary: Does not include the Riemann-Siegel endpoint residual.

rows.claim: The finite-sum theorem must not be promoted to a global corrected remainder.
rows.formula: The fixed-N Dirichlet residual is closed. A global corrected remainder still needs the heat-integrated endpoint a^-2 bound and one adjacent-cutoff comparison for the new signed lift.
rows.proof_boundary: Endpoint a^-2 control, the signed adjacent-cutoff lift, contact exclusion, Lambda<=0, and RH remain open.
